# Nana Adjei Manu

> > Personal site of Nana Adjei Manu: software engineer and independent researcher specializing in programming language theory, operational semantics, and formal methods.

Features in-depth technical tutorials on functional programming (OCaml), formal semantics, and practical web development with modern tools like Astro and Supabase. Nana has worked at companies including Andela, HousingAnywhere, and Rhino, and studied at the University of Leicester.

## Key Topics

- Programming Language Theory
- Operational Semantics
- Formal Methods
- Functional Programming
- OCaml
- Lambda Calculus
- Small-step & Big-step Semantics
- Astro
- Supabase
- Static Site Development
- PostgreSQL
- Career Transition Strategies
- Strangler Fig Pattern
- AI Agents vs Chatbots

## About

- [Nana Adjei Manu](https://nanamanu.com): Homepage: Software engineer & researcher in PL theory, semantics, formal methods

## Programming Language Theory & Formal Methods

- [Operational Semantics: A Formal Approach to Arithmetic Expressions](https://nanamanu.com/posts/operational-semantics-1-formal-intro): Intro to operational semantics: small-step & big-step for arithmetic expressions
- [Operational Semantics: Adding Variables, Functions and Conditionals](https://nanamanu.com/posts/operational-semantics-2-functions-conditionals): Extend arithmetic language with variables, functions, closures & conditionals
- [A Beginner's Guide to Functional Programming with OCaml](https://nanamanu.com/posts/beginners-guide-to-functional-programming-with-ocaml): Intro to functional programming via OCaml from lambda calculus foundations

## Web Development & Static Sites

- [Building a View Counter for Static Sites with Supabase and Astro](https://nanamanu.com/posts/building-view-counter-supabase-astro): Tutorial: Add privacy-friendly view counter to Astro static sites via Supabase

## Career & Learning

- [Learning with the Strangler Fig Pattern: Replace Your Skills Gradually](https://nanamanu.com/posts/strangler-fig-pattern-learning): Apply Strangler Fig Pattern to career transitions & incremental skill change
- [The End of 'Sorry, I Didn't Understand': How AI Agents Are Replacing Old Chatbots](https://nanamanu.com/posts/who-are-all-these-ai-agents): How AI agents differ from chatbots: perceive-reason-act loop explained
